title: Inventory Claude format detection and parse-count bounds

findings.invariant: parseJsonArray refuses arrays longer than MAX_RECORDS=1000000
findings.observed: Claude applies that ceiling to the top-level conversations array only. chat_messages length is not capped.
findings.required_fix: P072 must decide whether to count messages, keep the conversation ceiling, or both — without a million-row fixture.

findings.invariant: Comment claims every snapshot parser applies MAX_EXPORT_BYTES, MAX_RECORDS, MAX_RECORD_BYTES, MAX_JSON_DEPTH
findings.observed: parseClaudeExport never consults MAX_RECORD_BYTES. Oversize text can parse and then fail validateEventInput (textBytes 1048576).
findings.required_fix: P072 should state the intended bound. Do not paper over by weakening EVENT_LIMITS.

findings.invariant: Each diagnostic code in parseClaudeExport should have a Claude-labeled case or an explicit shared-test citation
findings.observed: missing_messages, malformed_messages, malformed_content, invalid_timestamp, duplicate_id, conflicting_id, image/document blocks, thinking/tool_result, quote join, ChatGPT-shaped non-detection are absent from claude.test.ts. ChatGPT already covers dup/conflict/time on a different schema.
findings.required_fix: P072 adds only the missing Claude cases using /work/out/fixtures and coverage-map.md. Do not retest tool_use+attachments or non-array health.

findings.invariant: Registry/README claims must match implemented capabilities
findings.observed: README says snapshot importers never emit tombstones; Claude manifest tombstones:true and tests emit them.
findings.required_fix: P006 docs lane; not this packet.

findings.observed: Official article describes Settings → Privacy export of conversation data and account user data, email link, 24h expiry. It does not name conversations.json, chat_messages, sender, or content blocks.
findings.required_fix: Keep recognition keys as in-tree behavior. Do not cite an invented Anthropic schema.
